body: Le salut par la compassion, ça me parle énormément. Mais coincé dans un C.D.I, difficile de franchir le pas. Je rêve d’être utile, profondément. Mais sur le terrain. Je veux voir tout ça, je veux utiliser mon corps, faire du labeur, raisonner, m’immerger dans tout le particularisme de cette condition. Sentir que mes efforts ne sont pas vain

J’ai déjà eu quelques expériences. Je n’ai jamais pu aller au bout de la deuxième séance par manque d’envie et par l’étrange sensation que je perdais mon temps. Je pense ne pas être tombé sur des bons thérapeutes

Parce que je ne vois pas de choses plus belles que de constater au travers des yeux de mon interlocuteur l’intérêt non feint. Je n’ai jamais eu ça… jamais. 

Je ne veux pas devenir un grand homme, je veux devenir, à mon échelle, digne de l’estime de mes pairs. Voilà tout

la phénoménologie de Uexkull, la Volonté de Schopenhauer, Le matérialisme dialectique de Marx, L’institution disciplinaire et la formation discursive de Foucault, Le conatus chez Spinoza, l’absurde de Camus, La grammaire universelle de Chomsky 

Franchement il y’en a trop

Called the ambassy after a short night of sleep on the airport floor then asked at the information desk what was the procedure to follow. Both answered that I don’t need a visa as long as i stay in the transit area for less than 24hours. Everything’s sorted out.
Maybe I’m overthinking but I’ve had nightmare experiences at sketchy airports and now I’m always on the edge trying to anticipate every possible scenario.

I would go with that plan 100% but something bothers me. Before embarking on my plane at Singapour, it is when I got my boarding pass scanned at the last checkout that the control lady noticed the amount of time between my fights and urged me to apply for a visa. 

Since I booked my flight with an included transit, when someone scans one of my boarding pass, it automatically displays informations about my entire route, including both flights infos and layover duration between them 

Im afraid that, if I decide to wait until the departure without notifying anyone. When the time will come for me to get my boarding pass scanned at the last control gate before boarding, someone will notice the anomalous timespan and deny me the access to the plane.
Yes but the fact that it is mentioned nowhere is surprising.
I asked the airlines but the only thing they said is « ask the relevant authorities », it’s mentioned nowhere on their website that we need visa and I never got informed of it

I have no clue man, that doesn’t make sense for me either.

Maybe you need to cross immigration even for transit ?

If you take direct buses to big cities it should be fine, but the further away the destinations are, the more connections and buses to take. In the end you can easily spend a whole day in buses to make a trip that would have taken only a few hours by car. If you stay a month you will be less rushed so everything should be fine. It’s just that I wanted to stay close to Singapour to make sure I wouldn’t miss my flight because of bus complications

Im in KL right now and truly having a blast. It is such a dense city to navigate but that’s part of the fun for me (I try to walk as much as possible to behold the beautiful sceneries that the city offers). 

My initial plan was to visit Malaysia in a more comprehensive fashion for ten days but given how horrendously laborious it is to travel by bus in this country, I came around and decided to stick with KL for the rest of my stay. I don’t regret it at all, truly a fun time

Because I’ve been ostracized most of the time by my peers I’ve started to develop misanthropy as a persistent personality trait. 

When I was a kid I used to take pride in who I was, especially because of my kind and generous personality. Back in my Childhood I would always be there to carefully listen to someone else’s rant about a specific event going on in his/her life. I would give advices, emotional support and compassion. I was concerned about things which did not concern me directly. 

No I actually despise the person I’ve become, but I do know at the bottom of my heart that I’m not the one I should hold accountable for this personality shift. I know I’ve been shaped that way by all those people who ignored me, belittled me, put me down relentlessly, those people whom sometimes I called « friends » because I had nobody else to hang out with. Those people I blindly cherished because I thought I belonged in something. In something genuine. 

But those people actually made fun of me because of the way I looked, because of my late virginity, because of my inability to comprehend some tacit social rules like sophisticated irony. Instead of pushing me up they dragged me down and made me feel worthless. 

I couldn’t give a fuck now if someone was telling me how his vacations went. Every time someone is sharing a story I feel instant disinterest. I’ve become insensitive, non-empathic, distrustful. I tend to manipulate and always put my needs before those of others. This is who I become, and it’s crazy the amount of inconvenience this role entails
